en: Black‑and‑white view of a small wooden railway station building with two stories and decorative trim, set among trees. A sign on the facade reads "SAMVIK". Several people, including women and children, sit on a bench by the platform, while another child walks a bicycle near the entrance. Old‑style fuel pumps stand in front of the building. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century rural train station scene.
